## Purpose

Describe the user/research benefit and link related Issue(s).

## Evidence tier (select one)

- [ ] Educational or synthetic numerical output (no physical validation)
- [ ] Literature-compiled published observations (source cited; primary data not authenticated)
- [ ] Authenticated primary experimental measurements (attach provenance, rights and uncertainty)
- [ ] Documentation / accessibility / tooling only

## Scientific correctness

- [ ] Preserve native units and declared chemical identity; no unsafe implicit conversion.
- [ ] Distinguish software invariants from experimental model validity.
- [ ] If applicable: exact source URI, upstream commit/hash, original DOI, license and transformations are documented.
- [ ] Mark unresolved polymorph/protocol and out-of-sample performance assumptions.
- [ ] No real equipment or medical/safety critical control is asserted.

## Technical checks

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Added regression/adversarial tests for observable changes.
- [ ] Updated Japanese and English text where relevant.
- [ ] No unauthorized third-party full datasets, media, credentials or private data.

## Compatibility and review notes

Describe UI screenshots, schema changes, sample file size, performance impact and any independent reviewer requests.
